title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A guard that read half the code
summary: The guard that keeps every setting fallback in step with package.json only read one of the two ways the code writes them. Fifteen readings use the other, including the exclusion list that decides which files the whole extension looks at.

highlights.title: Both forms covered
highlights.description: The guard now reads get(key) ?? fallback as well as get(key, fallback), and resolves named constants. Coverage goes from 186 readings to 197.

highlights.title: Nothing skipped in silence
highlights.description: A fallback the guard cannot read is reported rather than passed over, and the guard is now checked against its own inputs.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fifteen settings readings used a form the guard never looked at, among them the exclusion list behind every workspace scan.
A computed fallback, such as one derived from the processor count, is accepted as it is; a fallback that cannot be read at all is reported.
